responsibility: Defines the base GCC OS configuration for Phoenix-RTOS targets. It installs Phoenix/unix preprocessor builtins and assertions, provides the standard C library link spec used for non-shared links, and adjusts the stdint type-selection policy so 32-bit exact-width integers prefer unsigned int over unsigned long when using newlib-style stdint generation. This header captures Phoenix-RTOS compile-time OS identity and libc/type-model policy.
